name: Zimmermann
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $600 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Printed and lace dresses, ready-to-wear, swimwear and resort wear, plus shoes and bags, sold through its own boutiques, its website and department stores.
origin: Founded in Sydney, Australia in 1991 by Nicky Zimmermann; Simone Zimmermann.

ownership.owner: Advent International (majority); Style Capital and the Zimmermann family (minority)

quote.q: I could never have achieved what we have without Simone. While the business has evolved and fashion has changed, Simone has been a voice of reason and a constant.

opview: “I could never have achieved what we have without Simone. While the business has evolved and fashion has changed, Simone has been a voice of reason and a constant.” — Nicky Zimmermann, co-founder, Our Story, zimmermann.com

craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed, as a retailer: 'Sisters Nicky and Simone Zimmermann founded their eponymous brand in 1991 … began in Sydney … selling them at Paddington markets'
craft_evidence.reasoning: No sampled page states a country, maker or mill, and the sustainability page mentions partner factories without naming any. The 1991 Sydney founding is dated and placed but is a designer's start at a market stall, not making.
